name: Eloqua API Auth Fallback
description: Authenticates to the Eloqua API with an OAuth resource owner password credentials grant, as a fallback to the interactive authorization-code flow.
project_description: Submodule of Eloqua API Redux. Provides Eloqua API authentication using an OAuth 2.0 resource owner password credentials grant as a fallback to the interactive implicit/authorization-code grant. It decorates the parent module's auth-fallback service so that when both the access token and refresh token have expired the client can re-authenticate non-interactively from a stored site name, username, and password, and it exposes a Drush command (eloqua-gt) to generate/renew tokens on demand for headless or cron-driven syncs.
